evals.query: do all one by one, commit in logical chunks
evals.setup: Node repo on branch fix/report-dates, whose log uses scoped Conventional Commits (`fix(reports): …`, `docs: …`). Nothing staged. Unstaged: src/reports/date.js fixes an off-by-one day when converting to UTC, test/date.test.js gains a test for it, and README.md fixes a typo in the install command. Untracked: test/fixtures/utc-midnight.json (used by the new test) and dist/bundle.js (build output that .gitignore misses).
expected_behavior: Makes at least two commits: the date fix with its test and fixture in one, the README typo in another
Includes test/fixtures/utc-midnight.json in the fix commit, and leaves dist/bundle.js uncommitted and says so
Types the fix commit `fix` with the `reports` scope the log already uses, and the README commit `docs`
Writes every header at 72 characters or fewer, imperative, lowercase first letter, no trailing period
Writes no body line that is hard-wrapped mid-sentence
Runs the verify step (`git log`, `git status --short`) after the last commit and doesn't push

evals.setup: TypeScript library repo on main. Staged: src/auth.ts changes the exported `login(user, password)` to `login({ user, password, clientId })` and updates its callers in src/. Unstaged: a half-finished edit to src/ui/banner.ts unrelated to auth. Earlier in the thread the user agreed the auth change is ready.
expected_behavior: Commits only the staged auth change, and leaves src/ui/banner.ts unstaged and says so
Marks the commit as breaking with `!` before the colon, a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, or both
Gives a migration path for callers of `login` in the breaking-change text
Passes the message to git through `git commit -F -` with a quoted heredoc, not several `-m` flags

evals.query: add a short "WSL crashes when C: is full" section to `docs/setup/wsl.md` commit directly to main
evals.setup: Docs-heavy repo on main with a clean tree. docs/setup/wsl.md exists with sections for installing WSL and mounting drives. The log uses `docs(setup): …` for changes under docs/setup/.
expected_behavior: Adds the section to docs/setup/wsl.md and commits it on main without creating a branch
Writes a `docs` header, scoped `setup` to match the log, that states the change rather than the file name
Writes no body line that is hard-wrapped mid-sentence
Doesn't push, since only a commit was asked for
